auth_details: API key via the key: YOUR_API_KEY header; self-serve signup at viz.greynoise.io
resolution_notes: auth.details: Auditor correct. Official v3 and Community docs only show the key header (headers = {"key": "..."} / -H "key:API_KEY"); Authorization: Bearer is not documented as an alternative for the REST API. Evidence: https://docs.greynoise.io/docs/using-the-greynoise-api and https://docs.greynoise.io/docs/using-the-greynoise-community-api
